meta: Homestay hosts use AI to reply to foreign guests: guests message at midnight asking about rooms, and hosts with weak English can still reply clearly.

muc.title: Guests message at midnight
muc.text: Foreign guests message at midnight asking about rooms. With AI, a homestay host with weak English can still reply clearly.

muc.title: Two-way translation
muc.text: Paste the guest's message into a chatbot to translate it, then type your answer in Vietnamese for AI to write in English.

muc.title: Describe the room honestly
muc.text: Send room photos, size and amenities, and ask AI for a short, honest room description.

muc.title: Keep guest details private
muc.text: Don't paste guests' passport or phone numbers into AI. Always double-check prices and availability yourself.

muc.title: Five sample replies
muc.text: Ask a chatbot for five ready-made English replies to the questions guests ask most.

thu: Ask a chatbot for five ready-made English replies to the questions guests ask most.
